title: Hold a licence to collect for charitable purposes
what: Act as a collector for charitable purposes only under a licence (or as authorised by a licence holder).

sources.title: Collections for Charitable Purposes Act 1939 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Subject to this section, a person must not act as a collector unless the person holds, or is authorised by the holder of, a section 6 licence

administration.who: Minister administering the Collections for Charitable Purposes Act 1939 (SA)

sources.title: Collections for Charitable Purposes Act 1939 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 11, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: The Minister may, in his or her discretion, grant or refuse a licence to any applicant and will not be liable to any proceedings whatsoever as a consequence of any refusal.
